description: Java class implementing asynchronous aggregation of time series data partitions, including processing of result rows, aggregation calculations, and result wrapping.

classes.name: AggregatePartitionsFunction
classes.description: Class for asynchronously aggregating time series data partitions based on specified aggregation type, key, and timestamp.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs aggregation on a list of result sets asynchronously, returning a future with the aggregated result.

methods.name: processResultSetRow
methods.description: Processes a single row from the result set, updating aggregation state accordingly.

methods.name: processAvgOrSumAggregation
methods.description: Updates aggregation state for AVG or SUM operations.

methods.name: processMinAggregation
methods.description: Updates aggregation state for MIN operation.

methods.name: processMaxAggregation
methods.description: Updates aggregation state for MAX operation.

methods.name: getBooleanValue
methods.description: Retrieves boolean value from a row for min/max aggregation.

methods.name: getStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves string value from a row for min/max aggregation.

methods.name: getJsonValue
methods.description: Retrieves JSON string value from a row for min/max aggregation.

methods.name: getLongValue
methods.description: Retrieves long value from a row for applicable aggregations.

methods.name: getDoubleValue
methods.description: Retrieves double value from a row for applicable aggregations.

methods.name: processAggregationResult
methods.description: Converts aggregation state into an optional time series key-value entry wrapper.

methods.name: processAvgOrSumResult
methods.description: Generates result entry for AVG or SUM aggregation.

methods.name: processMinOrMaxResult
methods.description: Generates result entry for MIN or MAX aggregation.
